_what: The controls the sidebar part draws that a show rule can hide (subject `control`, parts/ui/show/show-rules show-of.ts controlShown). Each id is a dotted path; a rule about any path it sits in hides it too. The frame's own controls are `<controls>.<capability>` (`sidebar.<capability>` for the window's sidebar, DesktopSidebar.tsx allows). A screen's row is the control its screen DATA names (surface `control`, records/workshop-screen-tool-records.json), which AppSidebar.tsx asks before it draws the row; `screens.<screen>` names them.

position_choices._what: Where the sidebar may sit. A rule of the frame's own subject (its `controls` path, `sidebar` for the window's sidebar) with effect `change` sets `position_choices` to a list of these; with one choice left the position control is not drawn.
